name: Falkirk
title: Falkirk —
title_em: Kelpies, a wheel and a Roman wall.
tagline: The Kelpies, the Falkirk Wheel and the northernmost edge of the Roman Empire.
summary: Falkirk sits between Edinburgh and Glasgow on the Forth and Clyde and Union canals. The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift linking the two, and The Kelpies are two 30-metre horse-head sculptures.
The Antonine Wall, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, marks the northern frontier of the Roman Empire.

towns.name: Bo'ness
towns.note: A heritage railway town on the Forth.

famous_for.title: The Kelpies
famous_for.text: Two giant steel horse heads by Andy Scott, 30 metres high.

famous_for.title: Falkirk Wheel
famous_for.text: The world's only rotating boat lift.

famous_for.title: Antonine Wall
famous_for.text: A turf Roman frontier built in the 2nd century.

sport.intro: Falkirk FC, the Bairns, have played in the Scottish league for over a century.

community.intro: The Kelpies have become an emblem of modern Scotland for the diaspora.
